format: 3D models drawn as SVG every frame, with flat SVG decal sheets
status: temporary production asset: procedural 3D models and hand-drawn decals built from the supplied references, pending an illustrator-made model sheet or Rive file

references.drone: IMG_2442.gif (UPLIFT quadcopter, 13 frames) and ScreenRecording_10-24-2026_17-35-25_1.mov (motion art direction)

modelParts.body: generalised cylinder: a spherical bulb rising into the curled flame tip; silhouette solved per pose; lit by a light that can move (the album cursor's)
modelParts.eye: a lens bulging out of the curved body: rim on the surface, iris and pupil discs turning toward the gaze, glints at the light's reflection, an upper lid shell, a brow on the skin, a closed-eye arch
modelParts.armL: tapered capsule from a shoulder anchor (the anchor moves forward while it holds the remote); abduct/flex/reach (reaches for points, see reachToward and holdRemote)
modelParts.armR: tapered capsule from a shoulder anchor; abduct/flex/reach
modelParts.legL: tapered capsule from a hip anchor; swings (shuffling as it turns)
modelParts.legR: tapered capsule from a hip anchor; swings (shuffling as it turns)
modelParts.shadow: soft disc on the ground, cast away from the light, plus a contact shadow
modelParts.remote: the RC controller it flies the drone with (album only): a rounded charcoal slab in the body's frame, about two thirds of the body's width, with a lighter face, two ringed sticks with Vodafone-red tips that tilt with its commands, a light, an antenna with a red tip; the hands hold its ends (holdRemote) and the thumbs rest on the sticks
modelParts.board: the hoverboard it rides in the album (ADR-0004): a deck in Vodafone red lofted from cross-sections, its nose curving up at the left end, outlined in the body's ink, two glowing hover pads underneath, a red haze on the floor; its own height and attitude, the rider lifted onto its deck

decalParts.mouth: mouth shapes: smile, grin, o, yawn, chew, wobble, snore
decalParts.blush: one cheek, used on both sides
decalParts.apple: green apple prop: whole, bitten, core (unused since ADR-0001)

procedural: the ride and the hover on the board (gait.js, drone-flight.js)
the rider's balance: leaning, knees, arms out
body heading toward what it looks at
reaching for the pocket button's rim

modelParts.hull: ellipsoid, lit by a moving highlight
modelParts.arms: four tapered capsules to the motor pods
modelParts.guards: four open rings, split into the halves behind and in front of each rotor
modelParts.rotors: two blades and a blur disc per rotor, spinning in the rotor plane, alternating direction

decalParts.lift-lines: hover lift lines (not shown: its motion shows the lift)

capabilities: flight model (drone-flight.js): spring-damper toward a target with limited thrust
hovers round its home, drifting on all six axes (x, y, depth, heading, bank, pitch)
banks and pitches into its acceleration, heading drifts, rotor speed follows the work
follows a slow cursor in the open space, keeping a little way off it
heart-path flight paced like a pen, only the heart inked
a soft shadow on the page, cast away from the light

runtime: No libraries: a small 3D kit (src/pocket/actors/space.js) projects the models with perspective; one requestAnimationFrame loop per actor runs the physics (physics.js, gait.js, drone-flight.js) and rewrites the SVG attributes; Web Animations only for the sleep Zs.
illustratorRequests: A model sheet for the mascot: front, three-quarter, side, back and top views with the flame curl's exact profile, so the procedural body can be matched precisely (or a 3D/Rive source).
The small spur on the upper-left of the flame and the notch under the tip, which the procedural body does not reproduce yet.
Mouth shapes for the full set drawn to the reference style (tongue, teeth, lip line), plus a three-quarter mouth for turned views.
Hands in three states (open palm for waving, fist, holding) and a proper apple-in-hand drawing.
Drone: the UPLIFT hull's exact proportions from more angles, the rotor blade shape and a vector brush for the hand-drawn heart trail.
Ideally a Rive file per actor whose state machine exposes yaw/pitch/roll, gaze x/y, expression and the clips listed above.
Eye: the modelled eye covers three-quarter and profile views; an illustrator pass on iris colour and the lid line would refine it.
